title: Stage 0 v2.0.1 callers truth set: ERPNext
built: 2026-11-07, before running code_index callers on these 20 symbols
method: grep -rnw NAME over every file of a clean `git archive` of the commit (the hit count is recorded per symbol)
every Python and JavaScript hit read by hand with its enclosing definition; the receiver of each method call was traced in the source (assignment, import, class body)
symbols are the definitions named in the frozen ERPNext questions (taste-graphify/erpnext/questions.json) and their direct helpers
rule: A caller is a call site (file:line of the called name) that invokes this definition by name at run time: bare calls through imports or the same module, self/super calls in the class (or its subclasses), and method calls on objects that are instances of the class even when the receiver's type is not written (documents fetched with frappe.get_doc, call results).

Not callers: the definition, imports, comments, docstrings, strings, calls to other definitions with the same name, and calls through string paths (hooks.py, frappe.get_attr, run_method), which are listed under dynamic.
Tests, patches and every other file in the tree count.
